TEMPLATE: Central player faces the camera nearly head-on, running hard with ONE red Australian rules football in BOTH hands low across his torso. An opposition defender on the LEFT is very close behind, reaching toward/touching the player's upper arm. Keep the defender's exact face, reaching arm and close separation as photographed: the escape happens later in the VIDEO, not in this image. Keep the runner's running-leg pose and close front-facing framing. There are NO visible goalposts. Replace ONLY the central player's head using the actual selfie person's face, never an invented lookalike; harmonise exposed skin and recolour the existing guernsey as authorised. Shorts, socks and boots stay pixel-faithful to Image 1. This MUST remain the exact same Scene 1 master photograph and frozen action pose, not a new runner or a newly generated action frame. The defender's existing unbranded black guernsey with a bold red diagonal sash stays unchanged; do not edit or replace him. Do not move the ball, replace the defender, create another player, show a completed tackle, show a kick or insert goals. Focused, recognisable customer face, no forced grin.

SCENE 2 — REAR THREE-QUARTER PRE-KICK, EXACT APPROVED MASTER. The navy-clad athlete is LARGE in the FAR LEFT foreground, viewed from behind and slightly to the right, running FORWARD away from the camera and toward the goals. His head faces forward toward the goals, NOT back at the camera. ONE red Australian rules football is held low securely in BOTH HANDS and has not been dropped or kicked yet. Preserve his running pose, hands, ball, head angle and left framing. Match the customer's HAIR from the selfie and harmonise exposed skin; never turn the head or invent a frontal face. Recolour only the central athlete's existing GUERNSEY to the selected team pattern. Keep original shorts, socks, boots, stripes and all garment details unchanged from Image 1. Keep precisely FOUR EXISTING white goalposts ahead, on ONE goal line, with EVEN spacing, two taller central goalposts and outer behind posts at about FOUR-FIFTHS (80%) of the central height, each with its original red base padding. Do not add, remove or move posts. Preserve EXISTING distant blurred opposition defenders in unbranded BLACK guernseys with RED diagonal sashes, including ONE running TOWARD the ball-carrier; others watch him. Keep the entire already-unbranded stadium, turf, crowd, background faces, goalposts, sponsor-free surfaces and lighting EXACTLY as in the master; no background retouching or reconstruction. NO ball flight, kick, extra people or camera-angle changes.

SCENE 3 — SOLO PREMIERS CELEBRATION, EXACT APPROVED MASTER FRAME. Central foreground player alone, facing the camera, neutral, relaxed, CLOSED-MOUTH expression with ONE clenched fist raised; other arm down. TWO small teammates are already cheering several metres behind him, one on each side, separated from him and not touching him. Preserve the master camera angle, player proportions, precise fist and hand positions, distant teammates, faces, night stadium, crowd, bright floodlights and gently drifting GOLD CONFETTI. REPLACE ENTIRE FOREGROUND HEAD AND HAIR with Image 2 SELFIE: scalp, haircut, hairline, shortness/length, density, colour, texture, ears and face. REMOVE ALL TEMPLATE HAIR — no spiky or longer template haircut; do not blend the two hairstyles. Preserve actual selfie age, facial geometry and neutral closed mouth. No grin, shout, extra teeth or face redesign in this still; a smile begins later in VIDEO. Harmonise the central player's visible skin as defined in shared instructions. Recolour ONLY the EXISTING GUERNSEYS of the foreground player and TWO distant teammates to the selected unbranded colours and pattern. Preserve every player's original shorts, socks and boots exactly as in Image 1, even if they do not match the new guernsey colours. Do not change the background players' faces, skin or positions. Keep unbranded stadium unchanged. Do not introduce an embrace, foreground teammates, new text, second fist, ball, trophies, extra people, new confetti bursts or camera changes.

sharedPrompt:
TASK: Precise photorealistic IMAGE EDIT, not a new scene generation. Two input images in order: Image 1 = the scene TEMPLATE, which controls framing, camera, action pose, football, other people, oval, lighting and stadium; Image 2 = the CUSTOMER SELFIE, the ONLY source for the central player's identity. Preserve the source composition.

CONSENT AND FICTIONAL CONTEXT: The subject's likeness is provided with their permission for this fictional, personalised AI-generated Australian rules football entertainment experience. This is not footage of a real match, not a news report and not an endorsement by any real club, league or player. Personalise only the authorised selfie subject, not background people. Maintain the supplied person's recognisable appearance and the supplied reference composition. This context does not override content safety requirements.

MASTER FRAME LOCK — HIGHEST VISUAL PRIORITY: Image 1 is a LOCKED ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH, never a suggestion for a newly generated scene. Edit ONLY the central player's visible head/hair or partial rear-view profile, their exposed skin tone, and the central player's existing GUERNSEY colours and pattern ONLY. All other garments are LOCKED to Image 1; never modify them. In Scene 3 only, recolour the two distant teammates' existing guernseys. EVERYTHING ELSE MUST STAY AS IN IMAGE 1: exact camera, crop, pose, body/head angle, athlete position and size, football, goalposts, background players, stadium, confetti, lighting and all object positions. Do not redraw, relocate or rotate people or objects, regenerate the background, or expose facial features hidden by the approved view. The master images are already free of branding.

SCENE-SPECIFIC CAMERA RULE: In SCENES 1 and 3, replace the clearly visible foreground face. In SCENE 2, the approved REAR THREE-QUARTER master shows the athlete from behind; maintaining that exact view takes priority over face visibility. Match the person's hair length, texture, colour and hairline, visible ear/profile where available, and visible complexion only. DO NOT invent or reveal a front-facing face, turn the head or shoulders, rotate the torso, change the camera, or move the four existing goalposts. SCENE 2 IS NOT A FRONT-FACING SELFIE REPLACEMENT.

SELFIE IDENTITY LOCK — MANDATORY: Image 2 is the ONLY facial source, NOT inspiration. In Scenes 1 and 3 replace the TEMPLATE HEAD AND ALL TEMPLATE HAIR with the actual selfie person's entire visible head: face, scalp, hairline, hair length, hair colour, texture, density and silhouette. TEMPLATE HAIR IS NOT PROTECTED, even under the master-frame lock. Use selfie facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, cheeks, jaw, age and skin texture. Do not retain the template man's facial features. NEVER retain template hair, add spiky hair, lengthen short hair, blend hairstyles, or generate a younger lookalike. Fit only scale, lighting and head orientation. In Scene 3 preserve a neutral closed-mouth selfie expression: NO invented smile, shout, new teeth or wide-open mouth in the STILL; smiling starts later in VIDEO. In Scene 2 match only visible rear hair/profile without turning the head.

SKIN TONE AND LIGHTING — CRITICAL, EQUAL PRIORITY TO FACE IDENTITY: The SELFIE determines skin complexion. After applying the permitted scene-specific identity edit, harmonise the central player's ENTIRE visible skin from face (when shown), ears, jaw, neck, shoulders, upper arms, forearms, hands, thighs, knees and calves into ONE coherent natural skin tone. Recolour the template body's strongly orange/tanned/saturated skin to the customer's natural complexion; do NOT leave an orange muscular body attached to a pale face. Do NOT artificially tan, darken or redden the customer's face to match the old template body. Match stadium light and skin texture across face and limbs. No visible face-swap edge, colour seam at jaw/collar, contrasting hands or different neck colour. Match face and shoulders under the same lighting.

INTEGRATION: Blend face and body naturally. Preserve the customer's recognisable facial structure, real skin texture, hairstyle, hairline and age while making head and body skin tones visually consistent. Preserve the template's running/celebration body pose, proportions, guernsey, hand positions and stadium composition. Keep existing body proportions. Keep the head correctly sized and oriented for the template. Do not blend the template athlete's facial identity into the customer. NEVER recolour the other players' skin or faces.

TEAM EDIT — GUERNSEY ONLY: Recolour the central player's existing guernsey to the selected unbranded guernsey colours/pattern. NEVER modify shorts, socks, boots or other clothing: keep original colour, stripes, cut, trim and folds exactly, even if they do not match the guernsey. Never extend guernsey stripes onto shorts. Preserve pose, arms and ball. In Scene 3 only, recolour the TWO distant background teammates' existing guernseys to the same selected pattern without moving or changing their faces or bodies. Opposition players and scenery stay exactly as photographed. Never add a club crest, sponsor mark or lettering.

DO NOT RECOMPOSE: Keep the exact viewpoint, subject size/position, posture, depth of field, crowd, goalposts, ball, hands, opposition, stadium and confetti. Use the already-clean master background unchanged. Never add new people, posts, balls, text, logos, advertising or accessories. Never insert the selfie background or change other identities. The only personalised identity is the central player. OUTPUT: One natural, high-detail vertical 9:16 still with the master composition intact.
